0.title: API Reference
0.content: This page provides the comprehensive cmdlet API reference for PHWriter.

1.title: Public Cmdlets Summary
1.content: | Cmdlet | Alias | Purpose / Description | . | New-PHWriter | — | Render full help documentation | . | Write-PHAsciiLogo | — | Render the themed ASCII banner only | . | Export-PHWriterMetadata | phextract | Extract cmdlet metadata from source via AST | . | Invoke-PHPager | phpager | Display content in an interactive TUI pager | . | New-PHRouter | phroute | Dispatch CLI subcommands with tab-completion | . | Show-PHTheme | — | Preview built-in and custom themes | . | Get-TerminalPalette | terpal, Get-TerminalPallete | Generate dynamic solid, conditional, or gradient palette objects | . | New-AsciiTokenGradient | — | Apply token-aware ANSI gradients to ASCII art | .

2.title: 1. New-PHWriter
2.content: Generates the fully styled terminal help layouts. Syntax . New-PHWriter [-Name <String>] [-CommandInfo <Hashtable>] [-ParamTable <Hashtable[]>] [-Subcommands <Hashtable[]>] [-Examples <String[]>] [-Version <String>] [-Padding <Int>] [-Indent <Int>] [-LineSpacing <Int>] [-Compact] [-SourceType <String>] [-Theme <String|Hashtable>] [-Layout <String>] [-CustomLogo <String>] [-Gradient] [-CustomGradient <Int[]>] [-GradientMode <String>] [-OuterBorder] [-BorderGradient] [-BorderCustomGradient <Int[]>] [-OuterBorderStyle <String>] [-Width <Object>] [-JsonFile <String>] [-OutMode <String>] [-KeepOutput] [-Help] . Parameters . | Parameter | Type | Default | Description | . | -Name | String | 'PHW' | Module, script, or tool name displayed in the banner. | . | -CommandInfo | Hashtable | — | Contains cmdlet, synopsis, description, and source URL keys. | . | -ParamTable | Hashtable[] | — | Array of parameters defining names, types, mandatory flags, and descriptions. | . | -Subcommands | Hashtable[] | — | Array of router subcommands for router layouts. | . | -Examples | String[] | — | Array of sample usage commands. | . | -Version | String | '1.0.0' | Version number string. | . | -Padding | Int | 3 | Columns layout spacing. | . | -Indent | Int | 1 | Left padding offset. | . | -LineSpacing | Int | 1 | Empty lines between parameters (0=compact, 1=default, 2=spacious). | . | -Compact | Switch | — | Convenience switch for -LineSpacing 0. | . | -SourceType | String | 'module' | Layout header label: module, script, tool, plugin, cli, function, or workflow. | . | -Theme | String|Hashtable | 'phwriter' | Target theme name or custom theme hashtable. | . | -Layout | String | 'Box' | ASCII title layout style: Box, Classic, Minimal, Man, Terminal, Typewriter. | . | -CustomLogo | String | — | Overrides logo with custom ASCII text. | . | -Gradient | Switch | — | Enables title gradient shading. | . | -CustomGradient | Int[] | — | Custom gradient color-index stops. | . | -GradientMode | String | 'Horizontal' | Gradient distribution: Horizontal, Vertical, or PerToken. | . | -OuterBorder | Switch | — | Wraps layout in an outer border frame. | . | -BorderGradient | Switch | — | Gradient shader for the outer border. | . | -BorderCustomGradient | Int[] | — | Custom border gradient stops. | . | -OuterBorderStyle | String | 'Rounded' | Border glyph set: Rounded, Square, Double, Block, or Simple. | . | -Width | Object | 'full' | full, man, or a custom column width. | . | -JsonFile | String | — | Path to a .json configuration file. | . | -OutMode | String | 'Auto' | Render mode: Standard (stdout), Alt (pager), String (returns text), or Auto. | . | -KeepOutput | Switch | Enabled | Keeps pager output in the standard buffer after exit. | . | -Help | Switch | — | Renders PHWriter-formatted command help. | .

3.title: 2. Show-PHTheme
3.content: DX utility to preview theme combinations directly in the shell. Syntax . Show-PHTheme [-Name <String>] [-Layout <String>] [-All] [-Minimal] [-Compact] [-Gradient] [-CustomGradient <Int[]>] [-OuterBorder] [-BorderGradient] [-BorderCustomGradient <Int[]>] [-GradientMode <String>] [-SourceType <String>] [-TextSpacing] [-OuterBorderStyle <String>] [-Help] . Parameters . | Parameter | Type | Default | Description | . | -Name | String | 'phwriter' | Theme name to preview, or 'all', or 'custom-rgb'. | . | -Layout | String | 'Box' | Title layout preview style. | . | -All | Switch | — | Previews all 50 built-in themes sequentially. | . | -Minimal | Switch | — | Skips description/parameters; renders header title only. | . | -Compact | Switch | — | Shortcut for compact parameter line spacing. | . | -Gradient | Switch | — | Preview header gradient. | . | -CustomGradient | Int[] | — | Custom gradient stops. | . | -GradientMode | String | 'Horizontal' | Gradient distribution: Horizontal, Vertical, or PerToken. | . | -OuterBorder | Switch | — | Renders border frame outline. | . | -BorderGradient | Switch | — | Gradient shader for border frame. | . | -BorderCustomGradient | Int[] | — | Custom border gradient stops. | . | -SourceType | String | 'module' | Header layout category parameter. | . | -TextSpacing | Switch | — | Adjust spacing layout density. | . | -OuterBorderStyle | String | 'Rounded' | Border glyph set for -OuterBorder. | . | -Help | Switch | — | Renders PHWriter-formatted command help. | .

4.title: 3. Export-PHWriterMetadata (Alias: phextract)
4.content: Statically parses .ps1/.psm1 source code using the AST parser to compile documentation metadata. Syntax . Export-PHWriterMetadata [-Path] <String> [-FunctionName <String>] [-OutputJson <String>] [-ModuleName <String>] [-Version <String>] [-Source <String>] . Parameters . | Parameter | Type | Default | Description | . | -Path | String | (Mandatory) | Path to the PowerShell file. | . | -FunctionName | String | — | Restricts extraction to a specific function name. | . | -OutputJson | String | — | Serializes extracted metadata directly to a JSON file. | . | -ModuleName | String | — | Overrides module name in metadata. | . | -Version | String | '1.0.0' | Overrides version metadata. | . | -Source | String | — | Documentation link URL. | . | -Help | Switch | — | Renders PHWriter-formatted command help. | .

5.title: 4. Invoke-PHPager (Alias: phpager)
5.content: Renders text streams in an interactive TUI paging container. Syntax . Invoke-PHPager [-Content] <String[]> [-Title <String>] [-PageSize <Int>] [-NoColor] [-Theme <String|Hashtable>] [-OnResize <ScriptBlock>] [-KeepOutput] [-Help] . Parameters . | Parameter | Type | Default | Description | . | -Content | String[] | (Mandatory) | Array of strings representing screen pages. | . | -Title | String | 'PH Pager' | Title text displayed in the header chrome. | . | -PageSize | Int | Console height | Optional number of visible content rows. | . | -Theme | String | 'phwriter' | Style theme applied to border and footer controls. | . | -NoColor | Switch | — | Disables ANSI coloring sequences. | . | -OnResize | ScriptBlock | — | Callback invoked when console dimensions change. | . | -KeepOutput | Switch | Enabled | Keeps the rendered page in the standard buffer after exit. | . | -Help | Switch | — | Renders PHWriter-formatted command help. | .

6.title: 5. New-PHRouter (Alias: phroute)
6.content: Configures CLI subcommand dispatching and fuzzy recommendations. Syntax . New-PHRouter [-Routes] <Hashtable> [-ArgumentList <String[]>] [-ModuleName <String>] [-RegisterCompleter] [-Metadata <Object>] [-Theme <String|Hashtable>] [-Help] . Parameters . | Parameter | Type | Default | Description | . | -Routes | Hashtable | (Mandatory) | Subcommand mapping: name (string) ➔ scriptblock or function name. | . | -ArgumentList | String[] | Current argument list | Arguments list to process (typically $args). | . | -ModuleName | String | 'PHRouter' | CLI name used in error prompts. | . | -RegisterCompleter | Switch | — | Auto-registers argument tab completion. | . | -Metadata | Object | — | Optional PHWriter metadata used for router help. | . | -Theme | String | 'phwriter' | Theme applied to error message recommendations. | . | -Help | Switch | — | Renders PHWriter-formatted command help. | .

7.title: 6. Write-PHAsciiLogo
7.content: Renders the themed ASCII logo banner alone. Syntax . Write-PHAsciiLogo [-Name] <String> [-Layout <String>] [-Theme <String>] [-Version <String>] [-Gradient] [-CustomGradient <Int[]>] [-GradientMode <String>] [-Help] .

8.title: 7. Get-TerminalPalette (Aliases: terpal, Get-TerminalPallete)
8.content: Helper to compile dynamic palette color maps. Syntax . Get-TerminalPalette [-ColorMode] <String> [-GradientStart <Int[]>] [-GradientEnd <Int[]>] [-ColorPalette <Hashtable>] [-ColorThresholds <Hashtable>] [-CurrentValue <Int>] [-MaxValue <Int>] ### Parameters | Parameter | Type | Default | Description |---|---|---|---| `-ColorPalette` | Hashtable | — | Static named colour map. | `-ColorMode` | String | — | `Solid`, `Conditional`, or `Gradient`. | `-ColorThresholds` | Hashtable | — | Threshold-to-colour map for conditional mode. | `-GradientStart` | Int[] | — | RGB start triplet. | `-GradientEnd` | Int[] | — | RGB end triplet. | `-CurrentValue` | Int | `0` | Value evaluated in conditional mode. | `-MaxValue` | Int | `100` | Upper bound used by callers. | --- ## 8. New-AsciiTokenGradient Applies a colour gradient per glyph position or connected ASCII-art token. ```powershell New-AsciiTokenGradient [-Lines] <String[]> [-StartColor <Object>] [-EndColor <Object>] [-Mode <String>] [-Connectivity <Int>] . | Parameter | Type | Default | Description |—|—|—|—| -Lines | String[] | (Mandatory) | ASCII-art lines accepted from the pipeline. | -StartColor | Object | 0,150,255 | Named colour or RGB triplet at the gradient start. | -EndColor | Object | 255,0,150 | Named colour or RGB triplet at the gradient end. | -Mode | String | 'Horizontal' | Horizontal, Vertical, or PerToken. | -Connectivity | Int | 8 | Connected-component neighbourhood: 4 or 8. | ``` .

9.title: CLI Routing
9.content: PHWriter provides a lightweight router helper New-PHRouter (aliased as phroute) to build command-line tools with complex subcommand hierarchies and built-in help. Use it when a PowerShell command is a CLI entrypoint with a stable subcommand surface. Route values can be scriptblocks or function names; default handles missing input and unknown commands receive a closest-match suggestion.

10.title: Example CLI Entrypoint
10.content: function Invoke-MyCli { [CmdletBinding()] param( [Parameter(ValueFromRemainingArguments = $true)] [string[]]$Args ) $Routes = @{ 'build' = { param($Remaining) Write-Host "Building project..." } 'test' = { param($Remaining) Invoke-Pester } 'default' = { Write-Host "Usage: mycli <build|test>" } } New-PHRouter -Routes $Routes -ArgumentList $Args } .

11.title: Fuzzy Command Matching
11.content: If the user types a command that doesn’t match exactly, the routing engine calculates Levenshtein distances and recommends the closest subcommand automatically.

12.title: Router Help
12.content: Pass -Metadata when the router needs PHWriter-formatted help. This keeps CLI dispatch separate from help rendering while allowing a command to expose standard help as a route.

22.title: Quick Start
22.content: Initialize, render, and page help details in seconds: . # Import the module Import-Module PHWriter # Render the built-in theme preview Show-PHTheme -Name 'phwriter' # Generate documentation with a specific theme and compact layout New-PHWriter @MyMetadata -Theme 'cyberpunk' -Compact .

25.title: Metadata Extraction
25.content: PHWriter includes an AST-powered extraction engine called Export-PHWriterMetadata (aliased as phextract) that extracts parameters, descriptions, and syntax information from your PowerShell cmdlet files statically.

27.title: How It Works
27.content: . | AST Parsing: The cmdlet parses the PowerShell script’s Abstract Syntax Tree (AST). | CBH Association: It parses Comment-Based Help (CBH) blocks placed immediately preceding the param(...) block inside the function body. | Module Detection: It automatically walks up directory trees to find a .psd1 manifest file, setting the sourcetype metadata to module or script accordingly. | .

28.title: Placement Rules
28.content: To extract help comments correctly, place the comment block inside the function body, immediately before the parameter declarations: . function Get-MyData { <# .SYNOPSIS Gets some data.PARAMETER Path The path to check. #> param( [string]$Path ) } .

30.title: Generate a variant preview
30.content: $metadata = @{ Name = 'SAMPLE' CommandInfo = @{ cmdlet = 'Get-SampleData'; synopsis = 'Get-SampleData [-Path <String>]'; description = 'Sample output.'; source = 'https://gitlab.com/phellams/phwriter' } } New-PHWriter @metadata -Theme 'aurora' -Layout Minimal -Compact -Gradient -CustomGradient 39,51,129,201 -OuterBorder -BorderGradient -BorderCustomGradient 39,51,129,201 . The gallery’s command cards show the specific flags for Base, Rounded, Double, and Gradient output. Use any value accepted by Show-PHTheme -Name; New-PHWriter accepts the same 50 built-in theme names.

31.title: VHS source
31.content: New-ThemeVariantTapes.ps1 derives 200 tapes from the Show-PHTheme ValidateSet: four variants for each of the 50 public theme names. The vhs_build job renders them before the Pages build, so both theme pages use current module output rather than committed generated media.

32.title: Themes & Customization
32.content: PHWriter features 50 built-in themes spanning four categories.

33.title: 1. Base Themes (10)
33.content: These use solid 16-color or 256-color palettes designed for maximum compatibility across various terminal emulators. | Theme | Style Description | . | default | Retro Modern — neon cyan and dark green | . | matrix | Cyberpunk Green — high-contrast bright green | . | cyberpunk | Neon Synthwave — hot pink, yellow, and cyan | . | dracula | Dracula Dark — purple, pink, green, and yellow | . | nord | Nordic Frost — icy blues and clean white | . | monokai | Monokai — classic pink, yellow, green, and orange | . | solarized | Solarized Dark — muted cyan and green on dark | . | sunset | Golden Hour — deep reds, oranges, and gold | . | forest | Natural Autumn — forest greens and warm gold | . | classic | Old-School Man — monochrome bold and underline | .

34.title: 2. Gradient Themes (10)
34.content: These themes declare specific gradient steps and color ramps. | Theme | Palette Stops | Accent Color | . | aurora | [51, 93, 129, 201] | Cyan to purple | . | neon-noir | [201, 198, 196, 200] | Magenta to pink | . | lava | [196, 202, 214, 220] | Red to yellow | . | ocean | [17, 20, 27, 39, 51] | Blue to cyan | . | toxic | [46, 82, 118, 154] | Acid Greens | . | midnight | [17, 54, 91, 128, 165] | Indigo to violet | . | gold | [136, 172, 214, 220, 226] | Gold to yellow | . | rose | [161, 197, 199, 207, 213] | Deep to light pink | . | steel | [233, 238, 243, 248, 253] | Dark to light grey | . | phwriter | flat | Classic orange/yellow | .

35.title: 3. Extended Themes (20)
35.content: These use additional colour ramps and terminal-defined presentation characters. The website deliberately does not reproduce those characters: they are decorative terminal output and their appearance varies with the installed terminal font. | Theme | Gradient Stops | Description | . | glitch | [196, 201, 45, 51] | Cyberpunk Glitchy | . | cosmic | [17, 21, 57, 93, 129] | Space & Starry Night | . | forest-mist | [22, 28, 64, 106, 244] | Moss Green / Earthy | . | blood-moon | [232, 52, 88, 124, 160] | Dark Vampire Red | . | retro-arcade | [196, 201, 93, 39] | 80s Synthwave Arcade | . | abyss | [232, 17, 18, 19, 21] | Deep Ocean Trench | . | zen | [245, 248, 252, 255] | Minimalist Zen | . | blaze | [196, 202, 208, 214, 220] | Intense Fire | . | rust | [52, 94, 130, 166] | Industrial Rust | . | matrix-neon | [22, 28, 34, 40, 46] | Code Stream | . | quantum | [57, 93, 129, 81] | Subatomic Scientific | . | radioactive | [232, 190, 226, 190] | Toxic Nuclear Fallout | . | vaporwave | [201, 165, 129, 81, 51] | 80s Teal/Pink | . | nebula | [129, 135, 163, 199, 201] | Star Dust | . | crystal | [159, 195, 231, 255] | Diamond & Glacier Ice | . | copper | [130, 136, 172, 214] | Copper / Orange | . | royal | [17, 20, 21, 220, 226] | Gold on Royal Blue | . | desert-heat | [130, 166, 202, 214, 220] | Warm Sands | . | sheriff | [52, 94, 137, 180] | Western Leather | . | frost | [240, 244, 248, 117, 159] | Arctic Blizzard | .

36.title: 4. Hard-Bordered Themes (10)
36.content: These themes combine distinct border treatments with their colour configurations. | Theme | Description | . | drift-blue-orange | Double border with sky-blue and orange accents | . | steel-plate | Heavy industrial border and steel-grey palette | . | cyber-grid | Grid border with magenta and yellow accents | . | retro-blocks | Solid block border with a retro palette | . | gothic-crypt | Dark red gothic border treatment | . | acid-shards | Angular border with lime and green accents | . | aurora-borealis | Rounded border with an aurora gradient | . | solar-flare | Diamond border with orange and gold accents | . | subspace | Deep-space teal border treatment | . | neon-horizon | Block-and-shade border with pink and cyan accents | .

37.title: 5. Theme Variants
37.content: Every selectable theme has Base, Rounded, Double, and Gradient VHS previews. Browse the Theme Variant Gallery to inspect the generated output and copy the corresponding New-PHWriter command.

38.title: 6. Custom Theme Configurations
38.content: You can define a custom theme by passing a hashtable containing the layout color and formatting variables: . $CustomTheme = @{ AccentColor = 'yellow' AccentFormat = 'bold' BorderColor = 'darkgray' BorderFormat = 'none' HeaderFg = 'white' SyntaxFg = 'white' DescriptionFg = 'white' ParamNameFg = 'cyan' ParamTypeFg = 'darkcyan' ParamReqFg = 'red' ParamReqFormat = 'bold' ParamDescFg = 'gray' ExampleFg = 'yellow' DocsFg = 'cyan' SectionChar = '◆' HeaderChar = '»' BorderTop = '┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐' BorderBottom = '└────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘' BorderMiddle = ' ' } New-PHWriter -Name 'MyModule' -Theme $CustomTheme .

40.title: TUI Pager
40.content: Invoke-PHPager (aliased as phpager) provides an interactive, terminal-native paging view for reading long help pages without cluttered text overflow.

41.title: Keyboard Controls
41.content: | Key | Action | . | Up / Down / PgUp / PgDn | Scroll lines or pages up/down | . | Home / End | Go to the top / bottom of the content | . | q / Escape | Exit pager | .

42.title: Alternate Screen Buffer
42.content: By default, the pager runs inside the alternate screen buffer, meaning when you exit, the original terminal contents are restored cleanly.

43.title: Non-Interactive Host Bypass
43.content: To prevent blocking in non-interactive environments (like CI/CD pipelines), set the following environment variable: . $env:PHWRITER_TEST_MODE = 'true' . This forces the pager to print all contents directly to standard output and exit immediately.
